# the contributor analytic audit: retained caps, cone energy, secondary derivatives

All conclusions below are PASS with the stated scopes. OC is not proved.

## Physical retained-cap concavity and rigidity

Read all sections of
`candidate 38e8cdfda56d1d3d`,
including the successive T-then-E refinement. The hinge dual gives an
actual unique optimizing density. Conditional triangular transports of
the optimizing caps have positive continuous own-coordinate derivatives
and the correct telescoping Jacobian. Their weighted sum is triangular
and injective; repeated one-dimensional substitution is sufficient.
Coordinatewise weighted AM--GM gives the claimed density ceiling. At
equality the unique target density is an indicator, forcing equality of
the Jacobian bound. Repeating with any first axis gives equal normalized
projected quantiles and hence equal support functions of the normalized
centered caps. This proves the precise homothety classification, including
the superbody inclusion, without promoting cap equality to body equality.

Strict quasiconcavity has an independent short density proof: scale both
maximizing caps to the smaller mass, mix them, and use uniqueness. A
strict mixture of [0,1]-valued densities is an indicator only when both
are that same indicator, forcing identical marks. Positive-depth points
are inside their positive fibers by the finite-Farkas supporting plane;
all lower-dimensional nonempty fibers remain accounted for. Compactness
of the actual deepest set and finite-fiber continuity give attainment.
Integer-anchored combinations remain deepest and force equality of T;
equal volumes turn the cap homotheties into translations. Parity then
bounds translation classes, not selected mass or the number of bases.

The successive E maximum is on the already finite T-maximal set. Its
anchored closure allows joint E concavity and strict inclusion monotonicity
to force marked translations of whole fibers. The triangle/quadrilateral
tail example and nonaffine hollow-square graph correctly delimit the
weaker conclusions. No selected-stratum mass exhaustion is inferred.

## Cone projective energy and actual exposed-face limits

Read all seven sections of
`candidate e70b63e0e6efe01c`.
The normalized dual-cone slice is compact by the source interior ball;
boundary Laplace integrals diverge on translates of an actual interior
cone ball along a null ray. Fatou and a positive Hessian give unique
interior attainment. Homogeneity and the constrained gradient identify
the cone exponential mean exactly. The Laplace/Gamma integral has factor
m!/d!, with normal scale k/(d+1), and the printed energy coefficient
follows. The escort marginal has exactly exponent m+2 and conditional
normal mean L_F v; both mass and first moments have integrable tails.

For a nonproduct exposed face, Q=cone(pi K) is assumed actually CLOSED
and POINTED. Every q in Q then has the displayed actual representation
q=s pi(w), giving lower contracted-facet sections, including boundary
directions. Finite convex hulls of interior normal points give uniform
product exhaustion on interior compacts and a fixed source ball. The
upper bounded-normal inclusion follows from compactness and the face
identity. The positive dual normal controls the entire unbounded tail.
These facts justify the Fatou lower bound, fixed-parameter upper recovery,
minimizer convergence and escort limits. No uniform inner exhaustion
touching all cone boundary directions is asserted or used. Orthant and
simplicial determinant factors and the nonsimplicial square-cone ratios
check. the contributor reran3,246 exact supplementary checks.

the contributor's physical power-moment cone theorem has Defect independent analytic
PASS; root also reran its1,806-check independent verifier. Its own checker
has3,682 exact checks including actual compact simplex-cap certificates.
The quadratic facet specialization has Two-sided full analytic PASS and
24,331 checks. The energy and retained-cap recursions are different, even
though their geometric cone factor cancels in their ratio.

## Physical T first variation and centroid gauge penalty

Read every section of
`candidate cb7ea417552f0084`.
The actual radial shell expansion is uniform over compact hinge parameters
because hinges are uniformly Lipschitz and radial thickness is O(epsilon).
The mark derivative is jointly continuous, including parameter zero;
the hinge vanishes at a coincident cutting facet, eliminating a false
boundary loss. A uniform source inner ball bounds all actual minimizers,
so the two envelope inequalities prove the exact attained minimum of
old-hinge response derivatives. There is no derivative/minimum exchange
without compactness.

At the centroid the entire optimizer set is the negative polar body,
including boundary parameters. Its support function gives exactly
T'=-D-gauge_(K-g)(-B-|K|w). The independent ordinary centroid velocity
is -B/|K|, proving the unique zero-extra-loss drift. Signs agree with
the interval formula and Gauss--Green homothety calibration. Normalized
mixed secondary rows follow by the quotient rule. The interval path
y_e=e^2 with symmetric erosion correctly shows that first-order neutrality
does not certify actual deepest membership. No such continuation or
secondary variational contradiction is assumed.

## Deepest-energy constrained normal cone

Read every section of
`candidate ad7cea9b764c02b5`.
The unconditional relation a in N_Dp(y) follows from the positive energy
gradient factor and concavity. Actual unit-continuous-normal quantiles
describe the feasible point set; pure integer inequalities are constant
on the chosen base. Separation gives the lifted CLOSED conic hull with
quantile slacks, and conic Caratheodory gives approximate finite certificates.
Bounded multiplier assumptions are not silently supplied. The fixed-matrix
replacement-tilt argument proves near-active compactness when multipliers
are bounded. Supporting-section derivatives retain their correct one-sided
scales. The printed residual affine base term is not removed by continuous
normal balance. In the actual truncated-triangle calibration, the energy
base derivative is positive while every representation by the selected
critical menu has negative summed base tilt. This blocks the automatic
chart identification; it is expressly not a below-OC example.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
